# transmogR ![](reference/figures/transmogR.png)

This package contains functions for creating a variant-modified
reference genome or transcriptome. SNPs, Insertions and Deletions are
all supported.

With a generous tip of the hat and deep appreciation to Bill Watterson.
Results are expected to be more predictable than for prototype
transmogrifiers.

To install the stable version of `transmogR` from Bioconductor please
try the following.

``` r

if (!require("BiocManager")) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}
BiocManager::install("transmogR")
```

Alternatively, the latest build can be installed using

``` r

if (!require("BiocManager")) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}
BiocManager::install("smped/transmogR")
```

# Package index

## Modify a Reference

- [`indelcator()`](https://smped.github.io/transmogR/reference/indelcator-methods.md)
  : Substitute InDels into one or more sequences
- [`owl()`](https://smped.github.io/transmogR/reference/owl-methods.md)
  : OverWrite Letters in an XStringSet
- [`genomogrify()`](https://smped.github.io/transmogR/reference/genomogrify-methods.md)
  : Mogrify a genome using a set of variants
- [`transmogrify()`](https://smped.github.io/transmogR/reference/transmogrify-methods.md)
  : Mogrify a transcriptome using a set of variants

## Additional Functions

- [`parY()`](https://smped.github.io/transmogR/reference/parY-methods.md)
  : Get the PAR-Y Regions From a Seqinfo Object
- [`cleanVariants()`](https://smped.github.io/transmogR/reference/cleanVariants-methods.md)
  : Check provided variants for compatibility
- [`overlapsByVar()`](https://smped.github.io/transmogR/reference/overlapsByVar-methods.md)
  : Count overlaps by variant type
- [`shiftByVar()`](https://smped.github.io/transmogR/reference/shiftByVar.md)
  : Calculate new exon co-ordinates
- [`upsetVarByCol()`](https://smped.github.io/transmogR/reference/upsetVarByCol.md)
  : Show Variants by Impacted Columns
- [`varTags()`](https://smped.github.io/transmogR/reference/varTags.md)
  : Create a set of tags indicating overlap status with variants
- [`varTypes()`](https://smped.github.io/transmogR/reference/varTypes.md)
  : Identify SNVs, Insertions and Deletions
- [`sjFromExons()`](https://smped.github.io/transmogR/reference/sjFromExons.md)
  : Obtain Splice-Junctions from Exons and Transcripts
- [`digestSalmon()`](https://smped.github.io/transmogR/reference/digestSalmon.md)
  [`overdispFromBoots()`](https://smped.github.io/transmogR/reference/digestSalmon.md)
  : Parse the output from salmon
